newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end up sharply, off highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end up sharply, off highs.

text.p: May 20 - U.S. stock index futures ended sharply higher, off day's highs after busy trade. Some said strength in Nasdaq stocks, plus S&P 500 futures' ability to return to even higher high despite softening in T-bonds boded for more gains soon. June S&P 500s matched all-time high at 846.50. They saw big institutional buying, shortcovering in fast afternoon trade.
